question: Based on monthly sales data starting in January 2016 and using a centered moving average to adjust for seasonality, which products had a seasonality-adjusted sales ratio that stayed consistently above 2 for every month in the year 2017?
sql:
WITH normalized AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        CAST(mth AS DATE) as month_date,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(mth AS DATE)) as month_num,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(mth AS DATE)) as year_num,
        qty
    FROM monthly_sales
),
with_lag_lead AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        month_date,
        month_num,
        year_num,
        qty,
        LAG(qty, 5) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY month_date) as qty_m5,
        LAG(qty, 4) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY month_date) as qty_m4,
        LAG(qty, 3) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY month_date) as qty_m3,
        LAG(qty, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY month_date) as qty_m2,
        LAG(qty, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY month_date) as qty_m1,
        qty as qty_m0,
        LEAD(qty, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY month_date) as qty_p1,
        LEAD(qty, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY month_date) as qty_p2,
        LEAD(qty, 3) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY month_date) as qty_p3,
        LEAD(qty, 4) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY month_date) as qty_p4,
        LEAD(qty, 5) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY month_date) as qty_p5,
        LEAD(qty, 6) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY month_date) as qty_p6
    FROM normalized
),
window_calculations AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        month_date,
        month_num,
        year_num,
        qty,
        qty_m5 + qty_m4 + qty_m3 + qty_m2 + qty_m1 + qty_p1 + qty_p2 + qty_p3 + qty_p4 + qty_p5 + qty_p6 as window1_sum,
        LEAD(qty_m5, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY month_date) + 
        LEAD(qty_m4, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY month_date) + 
        LEAD(qty_m3, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY month_date) + 
        LEAD(qty_m2, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY month_date) + 
        LEAD(qty_m1, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY month_date) + 
        LEAD(qty_p1, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY month_date) + 
        LEAD(qty_p2, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY month_date) + 
        LEAD(qty_p3, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY month_date) + 
        LEAD(qty_p4, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY month_date) + 
        LEAD(qty_p5, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY month_date) + 
        LEAD(qty_p6, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY month_date) as window2_sum
    FROM with_lag_lead
),
with_cma AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        month_date,
        month_num,
        year_num,
        qty,
        (COALESCE(window1_sum, 0) + COALESCE(window2_sum, 0)) / 22.0 as cma,
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(window1_sum, 0) + COALESCE(window2_sum, 0) > 0 
             THEN qty / ((COALESCE(window1_sum, 0) + COALESCE(window2_sum, 0)) / 22.0)
             ELSE NULL
        END as ratio
    FROM window_calculations
)
SELECT 
    product_id,
    MIN(ratio) as min_ratio,
    MAX(ratio) as max_ratio,
    COUNT(*) as month_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ratio > 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as months_above_2,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ratio >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as months_above_or_equal_2
FROM with_cma
WHERE year_num = 2017
GROUP BY product_id
ORDER BY min_ratio DESC
